headline: Cramer Says “Sentiment Has Turned Vicious” As Previously “Red Hot Stocks Have Become Nightmares”
summary: Jim Cramer watched the same stocks that sparked a June melt-up lose half their value on identical earnings numbers, and he has a pointed explanation for why the market is punishing good results while rewarding Twinkie makers.
